content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-417. - I.P.C. Section703.5, Cleanouts on building sewers.
content.summary:
Section 703.5. Cleanouts on building sewers,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
703.5. Cleanouts on building sewers.
Cleanouts on building sewers shall be located as set forth in the Arvada Engineering
                  Standards."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
